results.gold_sql: SELECT T1.DIST_NAME FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_OILSEEDS_SUNFLOWER AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T3 ON T2.YEAR_ID = T3.YEAR_ID WHERE T3.YEAR = '1970' AND T2.SUNFLOWER_PRODUCTION_1000TONS >= 0.0 EXCEPT SELECT T1.DIST_NAME FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_OILSEEDS_SUNFLOWER AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T3 ON T2.YEAR_ID = T3.YEAR_ID WHERE T3.YEAR = '1966' AND T2.SUNFLOWER_AREA_1000HA > 0.0
results.predicted_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T3.dist_name
FROM fact_oilseeds_sunflower AS T1
JOIN dim_year AS T2 ON T1.year_id = T2.year_id
JOIN dim_geography AS T3 ON T1.geography_id = T3.geography_id
WHERE T2.year = 1970 AND T1.sunflower_production_1000tons > 0
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM fact_oilseeds_sunflower AS T4
    JOIN dim_year AS T5 ON T4.year_id = T5.year_id
    WHERE T5.year = 1966
    AND T4.geography_id = T1.geography_id
    AND T4.sunflower_area_1000ha > 0
)
ORDER BY T3.dist_name
